summary: Supabase migration testing iteration 5. All 32 backend API tests pass (100%). All key endpoints migrated from MongoDB to Supabase are working correctly. 1 known bug found: admin/sync-products always returns synced=0 due to missing 'id' field in the PRODUCTS list causing Supabase NOT NULL constraint violation. critical.issue: Returns synced=0 for all 13 products. Root cause: PRODUCTS list in server.py does not include 'id' field, Supabase products table has NOT NULL constraint on id column. Supabase error: 23502 null value in column id of relation products violates not-null constraint. upsert_product_catalog silently returns empty dict {} for all failures.
critical.rca: The PRODUCTS list defined in sync_products_to_supabase() has no 'id' field. The Supabase products table has id as NOT NULL. upsert_product_catalog() fails with 409/400 and returns {} for all 13 products. Fix: Add UUIDs to each product in PRODUCTS list (import uuid; 'id': str(uuid.uuid4())) OR make id auto-generated in the Supabase schema.

rca_of_sync_products_bug.root_cause: The PRODUCTS list in sync_products_to_supabase() (server.py line 2121-2135) does not include 'id' field. Supabase products table has 'id' column with NOT NULL constraint. When upsert_product_catalog() POSTs to Supabase, it fails with error code 23502 (null value in column id violates not-null constraint). The function returns {} for each failure, so synced counter stays at 0.
rca_of_sync_products_bug.reproduction: POST /api/admin/sync-products with valid admin JWT token → returns {synced:0, total:13, source:supabase}
rca_of_sync_products_bug.mitigation: Add 'id' field to each product in PRODUCTS list. Options: (1) Import uuid and add 'id': str(uuid.uuid4()) - but this creates new UUIDs on each call. (2) Use deterministic UUIDs based on slug using uuid.uuid5(). (3) Use the existing product IDs from Supabase by fetching them first. (4) Make id column auto-generated (serial/uuid default) in Supabase schema.
